versions.changelog:
- Removed the file: skill-card.md.
- SKILL.md introduction updated for improved readability and structure, with feature highlights in table format and clearer headings.
- No changes to core functionality or workflow. 
- Documentation is now more concise and user-focused.

- Initial release of douyin-realtime-search: a real-time Douyin content search tool using the Redfox API.
- Supports keyword extraction, sorting (comprehensive, latest, most liked), publish time filters, and pagination.
- Returns live (non-cached) Douyin data, including detailed statistics for each work.
- Clear user guidance, markdown result tables, dynamic filtering, paging prompts, and subscription for daily automated push updates included.
- Robust fallback and user-interaction workflow for no-result cases, with expansion word suggestions.
